name: Soap
description:
A firm bar of plain household soap with a mild, clean scent. It is useful for washing hands, clothing and ordinary cooking utensils when water is available.

One bar is supplied without a box or washcloth. Track gradual wear manually; soap has no automatic effect on disease, poison or magical contamination.

weight.notes: Quarter-pound bar, substantial enough for repeated everyday use.

name: Needle
description:
A fine steel needle with a small eye, suited to ordinary cloth repairs and attaching buttons. It is sold in a folded scrap of paper to keep its point covered.

Thread, scissors and replacement cloth are separate purchases. The needle is a domestic sewing implement, not a set of thieves' tools or medical equipment.

weight.notes: Two thousandths of a pound per needle, preserving a small positive mass rather than treating bulk needles as weightless.

name: Thread
description:
A small wooden spool wound with 50 feet of plain linen sewing thread. It suits mending seams, replacing buttons and other light cloth repairs.

The price and weight cover the entire spool and thread. Partial use is tracked manually. This fine thread is not suitable for lifting loads or supporting a climber.
saleUnit: One spool holding 50 feet of linen thread

weight.notes: Two hundredths of a pound for the full spool and its light wooden core.

name: Sewing Kit
description:
A folding cloth wallet containing two needles, 50 feet of linen thread, small scissors, a few plain buttons and modest cloth patches. It covers routine repairs to travel clothes and household linens.

All listed contents are included in the purchase weight. This is a small domestic kit, not a full set of weaver's tools, and it grants no tool proficiency or healing ability. Replacement thread, buttons and patches are bought separately as they are used.

weight.notes: Fifteen hundredths of a pound for the complete light kit, including its cloth wallet.

name: Broom
description:
A bundle of tightly bound straw fixed to a smooth wooden handle. It is a dependable broom for sweeping dust, dry leaves and crumbs from hard floors.

This is ordinary household equipment. It includes no dustpan and has no magical properties.

weight.notes: One and a half pounds for a full-length light wooden handle and bound straw head.

name: Mop
description:
Strips of absorbent cloth are secured to the end of a wooden handle for washing floors and wiping up spills. The head can be rinsed and wrung out by hand.

Sold dry, without soap or a bucket. A wet mop may be heavier while being carried; the listed weight is for the dry item.

weight.notes: One and a quarter pounds for the dry handle and cloth head. Retained water is not included.

name: Wash Bucket
description:
A light metal bucket with a rolled rim and swinging handle, intended for carrying wash water and cleaning supplies.

Sold empty. It holds up to 3 gallons or 24 lb of contents. The open top makes spills likely on a rough journey; there is no sealing lid. Water, soap and cloths are separate purchases, and any carried contents add their own weight.

weight.notes: One and a half pounds for the empty thin metal bucket and handle; a full water load adds up to 24 lb.

name: Wash Board
description:
A compact wooden board with a ridged working face and smooth handhold. Rubbing wet cloth against the ribs helps loosen ordinary dirt during washing.

The board is supplied without a tub, bucket or soap. It is a household aid and has no special effect on stains or substances that require unusual treatment.

weight.notes: Two pounds for a sturdy wooden board sized for use over a basin or small tub.

name: Clothes Line
description:
A 50-foot length of tightly twisted light cord for hanging washing between posts or trees. It coils into a small bundle when the laundry is taken down.

Pegs and supports are not included. This cord is made for clothing and light household loads, not climbing, lifting people or replacing full-strength hempen rope.

weight.notes: One pound for fifty feet of light laundry cord, substantially lighter than climbing rope.
